examples.english: The boy is happy now and enters the house.

examples.arabic: أهلاً دكتورة فاطمة، يبدو أن هناك سوء فهم؛ إذ قصدتُ أنني أُحب قضاء الوقت في المنزل، غير أنني مستعد لإجراء المقابلة الصحفية هنا الآن.
examples.english: Welcome Dr. Fatima, it seems there is a misunderstanding; as I meant that I love spending time at home, however I am ready to conduct the journalistic interview here now.
examples.transliteration: Ahlan daktoorah Fatima, yabdoo anna hunaka soo' fahm; idh qasadtu annanee uhibbu qadaa' al-waqt fee al-manzil, ghayra annanee musta'idd li-ijraa' al-muqabalah as-suhufiyyah huna al-aan.
examples.storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

examples.arabic: اتفقنا، فلنصلِّ العصر الآن بخشوع، وبعدها سنتعاون معاً في إعداد عشاء عائلي بسيط داخل مطبخنا الدافئ.
examples.english: Agreed, so let us pray Asr now with reverence, and after it we will cooperate together in preparing a simple family dinner inside our warm kitchen.
examples.transliteration: Ittafaqna, falnusalli al-'asr al-'an bikhushu', wa ba'daha sanata'awan ma'an fi i'dad 'asha' 'a'ili basit dakhil matbakhina ad-dafi'.
examples.storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

examples.arabic: هذه مشكلة كبيرة جدا ماذا سيفعل الآن ليشرب القهوة
examples.english: This is a very big problem. What will he do now to drink coffee?
examples.transliteration: Hadhihi mushkilah kabirah jiddan madha sayaf'alu al'an liyashraba al-qahwah.

examples.english: I drink a cup of tea now.

examples.arabic: هو يسأل اين ذهب ابي الان
examples.english: He asks "Where did my father go now?"
examples.transliteration: Huwa yasal ayna dhahaba abi al-an
